description: Points a subdomain, passed as host (for example chat), at the agency's white-label MagicForm.ai dashboard hosted on Vercel. Group route sets the CNAME. Group vercel adds Vercel's ownership TXT at the zone apex, only when Vercel asks for one; it is OnApply, so removing it later leaves the CNAME in place.
variableDescription: target: the CNAME target Vercel recommends for the subdomain (per project, for example b57c493806cd0fc8.vercel-dns-016.com). vercelverification: Vercel's TXT value after vc-domain-verify= (the full host name, a comma, then Vercel's code).
